eventPort.stateResync: urlChange/titleChange sequence gaps are repaired by the get-webview-url/get-webview-title (value, seq) query pair; faviconChange gaps by get-webview-favicon, whose result frame carries value: { href } | null plus seq (favicon_disabled rejects views created without the favicon capability)
eventPort.edgeRetry: extension-owned bounded retry (FIFO, 64 records) flushed on the next producer callback or after the next handled command; never blocks a native callback
eventPort.legacyFallback: without an attached port, the five unified families ride the command-response outbox flush (H0 host compatibility); the window-event family has no fallback — its 16 ms drain queue was deleted with the poll (contract-3), so a port-less host drops those records with a diagnostic

windowEvents.subscription: subscribeWindowEvents/unsubscribeWindowEvents carry frozen family names; producers submit through the EventPort only for subscribed names (no facade listener, no native observation record)
windowEvents.wireShape: { "type": <event>, ...payload } — byte-compatible with the retired drainWindowEvents payloads, so host listeners match on the same event names
windowEvents.retired: the drainWindowEvents command, its native queue, and the facade 16 ms interval were deleted in one compatibility decision (contract-3); permission draining is a separate request/reply mechanism and is unchanged

defaults.contextMenu: !bridgeSurface (any bridge capability ⇒ engine menu hidden; bridgeless child keeps the browser-tab menu; explicit value wins either way)

browserOptions.userAgentPrecedence: explicit override wins over browserlike shaping
browserOptions.windowsNotes: WebView2 default UA is already a full Edge UA; browserlike shaping is a no-op; incognito requires an ephemeral WebContext and stays unimplemented (persistent profile law); contextMenu maps to CoreWebView2Settings.AreDefaultContextMenusEnabled through wry's with_default_context_menus
browserOptions.macosNotes: contextMenu=false clears the engine context menu through the AppKit willOpenMenu:withEvent: hook (per-instance class swap adding the NSView override; objc2-web-kit has no generated menu delegate method)
